text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Milan Euro or never again
San Siro, 18:45: the derby push to start again
Como, Super 9
Victory and Champions League record
Historic 9-1 win in Lens; now they sit fourth. Douvikas scores three; he’s the top scorer. Fabregas: ‘We think about Inter.’
Napoli tension
Porto score four. McTominay’s fury, Hojlund accuses
Corriere dello Sport
Napoli exhausted
Max collapses against Porto (4-1). Seventh defeat in 14 games. Cesc, stellar football. Delightful in the Champions League
Fabregas show
Como make history; Lens destroyed: 9-1.
Record result for an Italian team: Douvikas hat-trick; Paz, Da Cunha, Kempf, Liberali, Baturina and 18-year-old Papaccioli score too. Suwarso’s club sit fourth. Last 20 minutes deadly for Allegri: now he’s 27th out of 36.
New Milan, Torriani saves
Maignan out due to suspension. Amorim: ‘Don’t think about the derby anymore; consistency needed.’ Only three points in three rounds. Ramos in attack.
Juve, the derby of the Koop brothers
A midfield duel: Teun crosses paths with Peer, who is two years younger. Lucio: ‘The club trusts me.’ McKennie injured: fatigue.
Spence changes Inter’s gear
Dumfries’ legacy, the injury, and now the assist against Feyenoord: Djed’s climb
Gasp and Roma with a double speed
Super starts and solid defence in the first half: just three goals conceded. Shocking finale against Inter, Real and United.
National team, Mancini calls Cisse
The news for France and Belgium is the Milanista. Zaniolo, Pisilli, Dimarco and Palestra return.
Tuttosport
EpicComo
History made in Lens: 9-1 and fourth place!
Never so many goals and such a large win for an Italian team in the Champions League. Douvikas hat-trick, top scorer, then Paz, Da Cunha, Kempf, Liberali, Baturina, Papaccioli: 9 goals, like Barça, City, and Liverpool.
Backed by Carnevali, Spalletti warns the players
‘Lads, it’s all down to you.’
‘Here, the players are accustomed to seeing coaches leave; now they must take their responsibilities.’ Cambiaso is necessarily on the pitch. Koopmeiners challenges his brother. Eyes on Kovacs, a transfer target.
Milan, a 500m push
Ferencváros clash at 18:45 while the agreement with Adidas makes the club rich
10-year deal from 2028-29 with the historic kit sponsor. Juve surpassed; Inter nearly doubled. Today, they must win at San Siro to climb the Europa League table. Amorim: ‘It’s worth more than the derby.’ Cisse and Ramos up front.
